definitions.laue_orbit: hkl @ R over the rotation parts, plus Friedel
definitions.canonical: max by (count of non-negative indices, lexicographic (h,k,l))
definitions.translations: mod 1 into [0,1), snapped to the nearest k/24 (asserted within 1e-9 of it)
definitions.laue_class_rule: registration 3.5 with 'a 4-fold / a 6-fold' read as a proper rotation (det +1) of that order
definitions.family_name_order: orbits by descending lexicographic canonical form, joined by ' + '
definitions.reflection_order: increasing |g|; ties (within 1e-12 relative of the cluster's first) by descending (h,k,l)
